title: A Well for the Hymn
author: Xanthe Galloway
blurb: Mara Okafor, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
